**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restore the probe fixture output path**

This consolidation deletes the tracked `fixtures/image-generation/` directory and marks the seam as fixture-module-only, but the repo still instructs users to run `node probes/image-generation.probe.mjs` and that probe's `writeFixture` writes `sample.json`/`fault.json` under `fixtures/image-generation` without creating the directory. When someone performs the credentialed image-generation fixture refresh, the live request can succeed but the first `fs.writeFile` will fail with `ENOENT`, so the probe evidence/fixtures cannot be refreshed; either keep/create the directory or update the probe and checklist to the new self-contained fixture location.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
